input.free_text_description: This system is a user management platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user detail, user info. The platform provides capabilities for common, common. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to create and manage user detail records, so that I can track and organize user detail data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user info records, so that I can track and organize user info data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with test data source functionality, so that I can accomplish my test data source-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with welcome functionality, so that I can accomplish my welcome-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use common capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
